title: Which of these eight expressions are even, without working them out?
description: Eight expressions with adding, taking away and multiplying are sorted into even and odd without working them out, using what two odd or even numbers do together. Two of them are checked by working them out at the end. Keeko raises the doubt that odd minus odd is odd.
teaching_notes: One idea: the kinds of the numbers decide the kind of the answer, so odd with odd under plus or minus gives even, and one even factor makes a multiplied answer even. Watch for students who think taking away two odd numbers must give an odd answer.

source: Without computing, which of these are even: 43 + 37, 672 − 3
video_script.why: A learner decides whether an expression is even or odd from the kinds of its numbers, without working it out.
video_script.anchor: eight expressions on cards, sorted into an even box and an odd box, as in the book
video_script.wrong_move: thinks taking away an odd number from an odd number leaves an odd number
video_script.payoff_line: Four of the eight expressions are even, and the other four are odd.

final_answer.value: Even: 43 + 37, 672 − 348, 4 × 347 × 3 and 543 − 479; the other four are odd
final_answer.spoken: four of the eight expressions are even, and the other four are odd

hold_back: Even: 43 + 37, 672 − 348, 4 × 347 × 3 and 543 − 479; the other four are odd
maths_rules: 43 + 37: odd + odd = even; 672 - 348: even - even = even
543 - 479: odd - odd = even; 708 - 477: even - odd = odd; 809 + 214: odd + even = odd
4 x 347 x 3 has the even factor 4, so even; 119 x 303: odd x odd = odd; 513^3 = 513 x 513 x 513, all odd, so odd
doubt: 11 - 7 = 4, odd minus odd is even
video_script.design: One idea: decide the kind of the answer from the kinds of the numbers. Assumes odd and even numbers and the odd and even rules for adding and multiplying. Wrong idea: odd minus odd is odd. The eight cards stay on the board and slide into the even and odd boxes.

beats.on_screen: title card Even or Odd Without Working; eight expression cards on the board: 43 + 37, 672 − 348, 4 × 347 × 3, 708 − 477, 809 + 214, 119 × 303, 543 − 479, 513³

marks.scene: the title card arrives and the eight cards line up
marks.ask: an even box and an odd box appear below the cards

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about adding, taking away and multiplying odd and even numbers.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Eight expressions are on the board. Without working them out, which ones are even?

beats.on_screen: the eight cards stay on the board while the child thinks

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: an even number as dots in pairs with none left; an odd number as pairs with one single dot; two single dots join into a pair

marks.even: dots for four sit in two pairs with none left
marks.odd: dots for five sit in two pairs with one single dot
marks.join: two single dots from two odd numbers join into a pair

narration: <bookmark mark='even'/>An even number makes pairs with nothing left over.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>An odd number makes pairs with one single left over.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Two odd numbers have two singles, and they join into one more pair.

marks.given: the eight expressions are written in two rows

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, there are eight expressions that add, take away or multiply.

beats.on_screen: To find: which expressions are even, without working them out
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find which are even, without working them out.

beats.on_screen: 43 + 37: odd + odd = even. 672 − 348: even − even = even

marks.odd: forty three and thirty seven are tagged odd and the sum is tagged even
marks.even: six hundred seventy two and three hundred forty eight are tagged even and the answer is tagged even

narration: <bookmark mark='odd'/>Step one, look at the numbers. Forty three and thirty seven are both odd, and odd plus odd is even.
<bookmark mark='even'/>Six hundred seventy two and three hundred forty eight are both even, and even minus even is even.

beats.on_screen: 543 − 479: odd − odd = even. 708 − 477: even − odd = odd. 809 + 214: odd + even = odd

marks.oddodd: five hundred forty three and four hundred seventy nine are tagged odd and the answer is tagged even
marks.mixed: the take away card is tagged odd
marks.plus: the plus card is tagged odd

narration: <bookmark mark='oddodd'/>Step two, five hundred forty three and four hundred seventy nine are both odd. Odd minus odd is even.
<bookmark mark='mixed'/>Seven hundred eight is even and four hundred seventy seven is odd, so that answer is odd.
<bookmark mark='plus'/>Eight hundred nine is odd and two hundred fourteen is even, so that answer is odd too.

beats.on_screen: 4 × 347 × 3 has the even factor 4: even. 119 × 303: odd × odd = odd. 513³ = 513 × 513 × 513: all odd, so odd

marks.factor: the factor four is lit and the card is tagged even
marks.odds: one hundred nineteen and three hundred three are tagged odd and the answer is tagged odd
marks.cube: five hundred thirteen is written three times and the answer is tagged odd

narration: <bookmark mark='factor'/>Step three, look at the multiplying. Four times three hundred forty seven times three has the even factor four, so it is even.
<bookmark mark='odds'/>One hundred nineteen times three hundred three multiplies two odd numbers, so it is odd.
<bookmark mark='cube'/>Five hundred thirteen cubed is five hundred thirteen multiplied three times. All the numbers are odd, so it is odd.

marks.first: forty three plus thirty seven shows eighty
marks.second: five hundred forty three minus four hundred seventy nine shows sixty four

narration: <bookmark mark='first'/>Step four, check two of them. Forty three plus thirty seven is eighty, which is even.
<bookmark mark='second'/>Five hundred forty three minus four hundred seventy nine is sixty four, which is even too.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Even: 43 + 37, 672 − 348, 4 × 347 × 3 and 543 − 479; the other four are odd

marks.ans: the answer line is boxed and the even cards slide into the even box

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Four of the eight expressions are even, and the other four are odd.
The even ones are the first, second, third and seventh cards.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the cards
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows odd − odd = odd, struck through; eleven dots and seven dots: 11 − 7 = 4, the left over singles cancel

marks.doubt: the bubble with odd minus odd equals odd appears
marks.dots: seven dots are taken from eleven dots and the two singles cancel
marks.fix: four dots in pairs are left, and the bubble is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks odd minus odd is odd.
<bookmark mark='dots'/>But take seven from eleven. Both are odd, and each has one single left over. The two singles cancel.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Only pairs remain, so the answer is four, which is even.
